title: MAS-BIT: A Multi-Agent System for End-to-End BraIn-to-Text Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.29457v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Speech brain-computer interfaces aim to restore communication by translating neural activity into text, yet end-to-end decoders have historically trailed cascaded systems in accuracy. We introduce a Multi-Agent System for BraIn-to-Text (MAS-BIT), the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings. MAS-BIT coordinates three specialized agents: a neural agent that interprets continuous neural representations, a phonetic agent that decodes soft phoneme posteriors, and an arbitration agent that integrates their complementary evidence with direct access to neural representations to generate the final transcription. The expert agents communicate with the arbiter through token-embedding-based latent communication, constructing continuous messages as probability-weighted combinations of token embeddings. translated_title: MAS-BIT：一种用于端到端脑信号到文本解码的多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 语音脑机接口旨在通过将神经活动转换为文本来恢复交流能力，然而端到端解码器的准确率历来落后于级联系统。我们提出了脑信号到文本的多智能体系统（MAS-BIT），这是首个基于皮层内神经记录进行端到端脑信号到文本解码的多智能体框架。MAS-BIT 协调三个专门化智能体：负责解释连续神经表示的神经智能体、负责解码软音素后验概率的语音智能体，以及整合两者互补证据并可直接访问神经表示以生成最终转录文本的仲裁智能体。专家智能体通过基于词嵌入的潜空间通信与仲裁者进行交流，将连续消息构建为词嵌入的概率加权组合。这些消息保留了候选的词元假设，并提供了一个可微的接口……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向端到端脑信号到文本解码的多智能体框架MAS-BIT，通过神经智能体、语音智能体与仲裁智能体之间基于词嵌入的潜空间通信协同工作，直接从皮层内神经记录生成文本转录。
en_tdlr: MAS-BIT is the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings, coordinating specialized neural, phonetic, and arbitration agents through token-embedding-based latent communication to generate final transcriptions.
